build.buildCommand: npm install --ignore-scripts && npm run build -w @pagebroadcast/types && npm run build -w @pagebroadcast/config && npm run build -w @pagebroadcast/validation && npm run build -w @pagebroadcast/meta-provider && npx prisma generate --schema apps/api/prisma/schema.prisma && npm run build -w @pagebroadcast/api

deploy.startCommand: npx prisma migrate deploy --schema apps/api/prisma/schema.prisma && npm run start -w @pagebroadcast/api
